S: Marinated salmon chunks grilled on skewers, with a dill yoghurt dip
Salmon chunks marinated in lemon, dill and olive oil, threaded onto skewers and grilled 2 minutes a side, with a herby yoghurt dip.
the glitzy casino city of Canto Bight

Fresh figs split and filled with gorgonzola, wrapped in prosciutto and blistered under the grill, finished with hot honey and cracked pepper on a gold tray. Cut a cross in the top of 12 fresh figs and press about 10g gorgonzola into each, 120g in all. Wrap each fig in half a slice of prosciutto. Grill on a lined tray for 5 minutes until the prosciutto crisps and the cheese melts. Warm 3 tbsp honey with a pinch of chilli flakes and drizzle over. Finish with cracked pepper and thyme leaves.
Paper-thin fried potato chips with sea salt and smoked paprika
Potatoes sliced thin and fried at 170C until crisp, tossed with sea salt and a good dusting of smoked paprika so the red shows through.
M: Chewie roasting his dinner over the fire as the porgs stare

Whole spatchcocked poussins rubbed with garlic, thyme and smoked paprika, charred over the coals, with crisp smashed potatoes and lemony greens. No porgs harmed. Cut the backbones out of 4 poussins and press flat. Rub with 4 crushed garlic cloves, thyme, 2 tsp smoked paprika, olive oil and salt. Boil 1kg baby potatoes for 15 minutes, smash flat on an oiled tray and roast at 220C for 35 minutes. Grill or roast the poussins at 220C for 30 minutes until the juices run clear. Wilt a bunch of kale with lemon and garlic.
Lemon oregano chicken, roast red pepper, cucumber and feta over rice
Chicken thighs grilled with lemon and oregano, over rice with roasted capsicum, cucumber, feta and a tahini drizzle.

Pistachio and vanilla panna cotta set overnight, pale green, topped with crushed pistachios and honey.
K: Let the past die. Cranberry and pomegranate juice, soda water, no alcohol
Cranberry and pomegranate juice topped with soda water, with pomegranate seeds and plenty of ice.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 2 hours, grill fresh

ingredients.item: chopped dill, plus extra for the dip

steps.text: Pat the tofu dry, cut into chunks and marinate in most of the lemon juice with the dill, oil and salt for 30 minutes.
Thread onto skewers and grill for 3 minutes a side until charred.
Stir more dill and the rest of the lemon through the yoghurt for a dip.
Slice the potatoes paper thin on a mandoline and rinse well. Dry thoroughly.
Fry in the vegetable oil at 170C in batches until crisp and golden.
Toss straight away with salt and smoked paprika so the red shows through like the salt flats.

Roast the capsicums at 220C until soft and blistered, then peel and slice into strips.
Cook the rice. Grill the chicken until cooked through, then slice.
Build bowls of rice with the chicken, capsicum, cucumber and feta and drizzle with tahini.

Build bowls of rice with the tofu, capsicum, cucumber and feta and drizzle with tahini.

s.note: Marinated salmon chunks grilled on skewers, with a dill yoghurt dip
s.how: Cut 600g salmon fillet into chunks and marinate in lemon juice, chopped dill and olive oil for 20 minutes. Thread onto skewers and grill for 2 minutes a side. Stir more dill and lemon through Greek yoghurt for a dip.

s.note: Paper-thin fried potato chips with sea salt and smoked paprika
s.how: Slice 800g potatoes paper thin on a mandoline and rinse well. Dry thoroughly and fry at 170C in batches until crisp and golden. Toss straight away with sea salt and a good dusting of smoked paprika so the red shows through like the salt flats.

m.note: Lemon oregano chicken, roast red pepper, cucumber and feta over rice
m.how: Marinate 800g chicken thighs in lemon juice, oregano and oil, then grill and slice. Roast 2 red capsicums until soft. Build bowls of long grain rice with the chicken, capsicum strips, diced cucumber, crumbled feta and a drizzle of tahini.

w.note: Pistachio panna cotta set in glasses with crushed pistachios and honey
w.how: Blend 100g pistachios with 250ml milk until fine, then strain. Warm with 300ml cream and 80g sugar. Stir in 3 soaked gelatine sheets until dissolved. Pour into glasses and set overnight. Top with crushed pistachios and a drizzle of honey.

d.note: Let the past die. Cranberry and pomegranate juice, soda water, no alcohol
d.how: Fill tall glasses with ice and a spoon of pomegranate seeds. Pour in equal parts cranberry juice and pomegranate juice to halfway, then top with soda water. Stir once so it swirls deep red, like a throne room with nowhere to hide.
